# Acme Widget

> Acme Widget is a small tool that formats widget manifests for humans and agents.

## Docs

- [Overview](https://widget.example.com/): what the tool does
- [About](https://widget.example.com/about.html): maintainers and contact
- [Install](https://widget.example.com/install.html): getting started

## Optional

- [Capabilities](https://widget.example.com/capabilities.json): machine-readable manifest
